analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Interleaved Boost Power Factor Correction Rectifier
* Auto-grounded net 0 due to GND:pin
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.ic v(VOUT)=385 v(V_COMP)=2.5 v(C_COMP1)=2.5 v(C_COMP2)=2.5
.model dmodel1 D(Rs=0.01)
.model power_nmos VDMOS(Ron=0.04 Vto=3.5 Kp=60 Cgdmax=15p Cgdmin=1p Cgs=150p)
VAC a b SIN(0 325 50)
Ra a 0 1e+07
Rb b 0 1e+07
L_EMI a a_filt 0.002
C_EMI a_filt b 4.7e-07
R_filt a_filt 0 1e+07
D1 0 a_filt dmodel1
D2 a_filt d dmodel1
D3 0 b dmodel1
D4 b d dmodel1
C_BYPASS d 0 1e-08
L1 d L1_node 0.003
VSENSE1 L1_node e1 DC 0
C_S1 e1 0 1e-09
R_S1 e1 0 1e+06
M1 e1 ctrl_gate1 0 power_nmos
R_gate1 ctrl1 ctrl_gate1 10
R_GS1 ctrl_gate1 0 100000
D5 e1 VOUT dmodel1
L2 d L2_node 0.003
VSENSE2 L2_node e2 DC 0
C_S2 e2 0 1e-09
R_S2 e2 0 1e+06
M2 e2 ctrl_gate2 0 power_nmos
R_gate2 ctrl2 ctrl_gate2 10
R_GS2 ctrl_gate2 0 100000
D6 e2 VOUT dmodel1
C1 VOUT 0 0.00047
R1 VOUT 0 400
R2 VOUT VFB 760000
R3 VFB 0 10000
VREF VREF_NODE 0 DC 5
E_V V_RAW 0 VREF_NODE VFB 100
B_V_CLAMP V_CLAMP 0 v='max(min(V(V_RAW), 5), 0)'
R_V V_CLAMP V_COMP 10000
C_V V_COMP 0 1e-06
B_MULT I_TARGET 0 v='abs(V(a,b)) * V(V_COMP) * 0.0015'
R_DUMMY I_TARGET 0 1e+09
B_I_ACT1 I_ACT1 0 v='I(VSENSE1)'
E_C1 C_RAW1 0 I_TARGET I_ACT1 100
B_C_CLAMP1 C_CLAMP1 0 v='max(min(V(C_RAW1), 4.8), 0.1)'
R_C1 C_CLAMP1 C_COMP1 1000
C_C1 C_COMP1 0 2.2e-08
B_I_ACT2 I_ACT2 0 v='I(VSENSE2)'
E_C2 C_RAW2 0 I_TARGET I_ACT2 100
B_C_CLAMP2 C_CLAMP2 0 v='max(min(V(C_RAW2), 4.8), 0.1)'
R_C2 C_CLAMP2 C_COMP2 1000
C_C2 C_COMP2 0 2.2e-08
V_TRI1 VTRI1 0 PULSE(0 5 0 9.5e-06 5e-07 0 1e-05)
V_TRI2 VTRI2 0 PULSE(0 5 5e-06 9.5e-06 5e-07 0 1e-05)
B_PWM1 ctrl1 0 v='V(C_COMP1) > V(VTRI1) ? 15 : 0'
B_PWM2 ctrl2 0 v='V(C_COMP2) > V(VTRI2) ? 15 : 0'

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
